concerns.text: The plan treats the derived theoretical lower bound on sample complexity (S_theoretical(N) = (2σ²/δ²)·1/N) as an exact target for empirical validation (e.g., deviation_ratio, TOST equivalence of slope, and direct comparison of empirical sample counts to the bound). A lower bound is not expected to be tight; empirical sample counts are only required to be ≥ the bound. Testing for equivalence or expecting a deviation ratio ≈ 1 therefore constitutes a methodological flaw: it may flag valid results as failures and conflates a bound with a true scaling law.
